verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is open-source and self-hostable, with no forced API keys or paywalls. Its own outputs are open formats: markdown, plus structured JSON from schema-based extraction, which the CLI can write directly (`-o markdown`). That limits lock-in, but the evidence documents no explicit bulk export of all user state, such as browser profiles or crawl checkpoints. Missing for 10: documented export of all stored state (profiles, sessions, resume checkpoints) in open formats, explicit data-portability/exit documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Open Source: No forced API keys, no paywalls—everyone can access their data.
Schema Definition: Define custom schemas for extracting structured JSON from repetitive patterns.
Dockerized Setup: Optimized Docker image with FastAPI server for easy deployment.
